name: io.github.Lokumbus/west-coast-charts-agent
title: WestCoast Charts
description: Validate, render (SVG/PNG) and describe WestCoast Charts specs headlessly, with a data table.

environmentVariables.name: WCC_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Premium licence key. Only for Premium chart types; requires the separately supplied complete library.

environmentVariables.name: WCC_LIB_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Path to an installed WestCoast Charts library (e.g. the Premium package). Default: the resolved west-coast-charts.

environmentVariables.name: WCC_DEFAULT_THEME
environmentVariables.description: Theme when a spec sets none.

environmentVariables.name: WCC_EVALUATION
environmentVariables.description: 1 = Premium types without a key render a watermarked preview (needs the Premium runtime).

environmentVariables.name: WCC_MAX_PIXELS
environmentVariables.description: Upper limit for rendered PNG pixels.
